stage1: uv run ruff check src/ tests/
stage2: test -d /tmp && tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/konstruktor-stage2.XXXXXX)" && trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT && uv build --wheel --out-dir "$tmp/dist" && uv venv "$tmp/venv" && uv pip install --python "$tmp/venv/bin/python" "$tmp"/dist/*.whl && mkdir "$tmp/work" && (cd "$tmp/work" && "$tmp/venv/bin/python" -c 'import konstruktor; assert "/tmp/konstruktor-stage2." in konstruktor.__file__, konstruktor.__file__' && "$tmp/venv/bin/konstruktor" --version && KONSTRUKTOR_LLM_API_KEY=stage2-placeholder "$tmp/venv/bin/konstruktor" run --dry-run --task 'consumer smoke test' --directory "$tmp/work" --output "$tmp/out") && if KONSTRUKTOR_LLM_API_KEY=stage2-placeholder "$tmp/venv/bin/konstruktor" run --dry-run --task 'negative path test' --directory "$tmp/missing" --output "$tmp/out-negative"; then exit 1; else test "$?" -eq 2; fi
verification.notes: Stage 2 builds the wheel, installs it with runtime dependencies into a fresh Python 3.12 environment outside the repository, proves imports resolve from that environment, exercises the installed command, and checks its invalid-directory failure path. The placeholder API key is used only for dry-run configuration validation and is not a credential.
